results.idea: Cross-sectional z-score of ts_regression intercept of FY1 predictions (60d)
results.description: ts_regression(star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy1, ts_step(1), 60, 0, 0) to extract intercept then zscore cross-sectionally. SUGGESTION1 used single field. Confidence 0.51 (intercept less informative).

results.idea: Cross-sectional quantile of smoothed absolute delta (SmartEstimate 7d)
results.description: quantile(ts_mean(abs(ts_delta(mdl30_new_smartestimate_f12m_eps,7)),7)) to pick names with consistent absolute estimate moves. SUGGESTION1 used single strong field. Confidence 0.58.

results.idea: Cross-sectional z-score of difference between current FY1 surprise and 30d mean
results.description: zscore(subtract(star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy1, ts_mean(star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy1,30))) to highlight recent deviations. SUGGESTION1 used single field. Confidence 0.66.

results.idea: Cross-sectional quantile of ts_rank of model percent changes (30d)
results.description: quantile(ts_rank(mdl30_new_psprise_pct_fy1_eps,30)) to find relatively high recent model-percent ranks. SUGGESTION1 used model field. Confidence 0.55.

results.idea: Cross-sectional z-score of smoothed combined signal: mean(FY1 zscore, SmartEstimate zscore)
results.description: zscore(divide(add(zscore(star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy1), zscore(mdl30_new_smartestimate_f12m_eps)), 2)) combining two normalized signals per SUGGESTION1. Confidence 0.72 due to diversified combination of orthogonal signals.

results.idea: Cross-sectional quantile of ts_max_diff for model percent vs FY1 surprise (30d)
results.description: quantile(ts_max_diff(subtract(mdl30_new_psprise_pct_fy1_eps, star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy1), 30)) to find big current deviation from recent max of disagreement. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Confidence 0.59.

results.idea: Cross-sectional z-score of ts_av_diff of FY2 (20d)
results.description: zscore(ts_av_diff(star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy2,20)) to capture deviations from recent mean for FY2. SUGGESTION1 used FY2 to diversify. Confidence 0.49.

results.idea: Cross-sectional quantile of combined magnitude: abs(FY1 surprise) + abs(model percent)
results.description: quantile(add(abs(star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy1), abs(mdl30_new_psprise_pct_fy1_eps))) to find names with overall large signals. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Confidence 0.58.

results.idea: Cross-sectional z-score of ts_std_dev of difference (FY1 - SmartEstimate)
results.description: zscore(ts_std_dev(subtract(star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy1, mdl30_new_smartestimate_f12m_eps),30)) to measure instability in disagreement; prefer stable disagreement. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Confidence 0.54.

results.idea: Cross-sectional quantile of smoothed product of FY1 sign and SmartEstimate magnitude
results.description: quantile(ts_mean(multiply(sign(star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy1), mdl30_new_smartestimate_f12m_eps),7)) to favor names where positive predicted surprise aligns with large estimates. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Confidence 0.66.

results.idea: Cross-sectional z-score of persistent disagreement: ts_count_nans-adjusted difference
results.description: zscore(divide(abs(subtract(star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy1, mdl30_new_psprise_pct_fy1_eps)), add(1, ts_count_nans(star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy1,30)))) to downweight sparse names. SUGGESTION1 used two fields and count_nans. Confidence 0.58.

results.idea: Cross-sectional quantile of normalized ts_product of FY1 3d and SmartEstimate 3d
results.description: quantile(divide(multiply(ts_product(star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy1,3), ts_product(mdl30_new_smartestimate_f12m_eps,3)), 1)) combining short-term consistency across both fields. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Confidence 0.61.

results.idea: Cross-sectional z-score of ts_arg_max difference normalized by 30d std
results.description: zscore(divide(subtract(ts_arg_max(star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy1,30), ts_arg_max(mdl30_new_smartestimate_f12m_eps,30)), ts_std_dev(subtract(ts_arg_max(star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy1,30), ts_arg_max(mdl30_new_smartestimate_f12m_eps,30)),30))) to emphasize significant timing differences. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Confidence 0.48.

results.idea: Cross-sectional quantile of recent upward revisions where model percent also increased (7d)
results.description: quantile(and(greater(ts_delta(star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy1,7),0), greater(ts_delta(mdl30_new_psprise_pct_fy1_eps,7),0))) to pick names with aligned positive revisions. SUGGESTION1 used two fields and logical operator. Confidence 0.65 for aligned upward revisions.

results.idea: Cross-sectional z-score of smoothed sign-consistency between FY1 and SmartEstimate (14d)
results.description: zscore(ts_mean(equal(sign(ts_delta(star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy1,1)), sign(ts_delta(mdl30_new_smartestimate_f12m_eps,1))),14)) to favor names with consistent revision direction. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Confidence 0.63.

results.idea: Cross-sectional quantile of ratio of 7d means (FY1/SmartEstimate)
results.description: quantile(divide(ts_mean(star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy1,7), add(0.0001, ts_mean(mdl30_new_smartestimate_f12m_eps,7)))) to highlight relative short-term intensity. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Confidence 0.60.
